_note: Candidate registry for Iowa 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (Iowa Secretary of State, Elections Division, Candidate List, November 3, 2026 General Election (Federal and State offices, last updated 8/19/2026 1:36 PM), linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: Iowa Secretary of State, Elections Division, Candidate List, November 3, 2026 General Election (Federal and State offices, last updated 8/19/2026 1:36 PM) (https://sos.iowa.gov/sites/default/files/2026-08/2026%20General%20-%20Candidate%20List%20Database%20-%20All%20Elections_1.pdf); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
